interpretation: The SGMC raster scores AUC 0.997948 against a target constructed from the same SGMC raster. This demonstrates circularity of the SGMC-derived proxy only. It is not a compliant feature-alone test on a whole-segment holdout, is not evidence of hidden-label prediction skill, and is not a score.
